instrumentationCaveats: The frozen wrapper did not invoke its aggregate verifier or require exact scene order/native exit success in its completion predicate. This review explicitly retains INCOMPLETE and records the aggregate time overrun.

One successful nonstreaming Sol preflight was mislabeled upstream-error by the ledger because error:null was treated as an error. HTTP 200, completed output and the forced tool call were independently validated; this is not an upstream HTTP failure.

Two Qwen scene snapshots still showed a final request as started at stop time; the final ledger later recorded completion. Per-scene cost/latency attribution around cancellation is approximate. Aggregate ledger totals are reported separately.

Opaque Code Mode service calls are attributed through a unique completed tool time window, not a cryptographic request/session binding. Recipient transcript model checks and outsider-access boundaries are not exhaustive.
Raw native contract PASS is not full acceptance. Acceptance is withheld where source/content/output semantics remain insufficiently asserted.
cleanup: Both owned native worlds were disposed; no live business-service preview is retained.
privacy: Only fictional Acme fixture content is published. No raw receipts, auth state, transcripts or paid key values are included.
